description: A CALL USING argument that is a group item with a level-number other than 01 or 77 — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 10: "CALL arguments may be elementary or groups with any level number. Formerly, they had to be elementary or have a level number of 1 or 77." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, CallBinder.ScreenCallOperand, once per USING operand (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: a CALL USING argument that is a group item with a level-number other than 01 or 77
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.4.3 SR3; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 10
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 10)
